name: vault-gdr
description: Sorgenti minimi YAML/Jinja/JS per vault Obsidian GDR.

scripts.build:plugin: cd plugin && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
scripts.check: python3 Dev/Tools/render.py --check && find Dev/Source/JS \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
